units.source_text: 今日又是整天谈论书法。

en.t: Again that day, they spent the whole time talking about calligraphy.

units.source_text: 源氏选出所藏各种继纸册子来欣赏。

en.t: Genji selected various bound albums of joined papers from his collection and admired them.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王乘此机会，派儿子侍从回家去拿些册子来。

en.t: Taking this opportunity, Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, sent his son, the chamberlain, home to bring back some albums.

units.source_text: 计有嵯峨帝所选录的《古万叶集》四卷，以及延喜帝所书《古今和歌集》一卷，

en.t: They included four volumes of the Old Manyoshu selected by Emperor Saga, and one volume of the Kokin Wakashu written by Emperor Engi,

units.source_text: 由淡蓝色中国纸接合而成，

en.t: made by joining together pale blue Chinese paper,

units.source_text: 有深蓝色中国花绫封面，淡蓝色玉轴，以及五彩丝带。

en.t: with covers of dark blue Chinese figured damask, pale blue jade rollers, and multicolored silk ribbons.

units.source_text: 式样十分优雅，书体每卷不同，笔墨异常精美。

en.t: Their style was exceedingly elegant; the calligraphy differed from volume to volume, and the brushwork and ink were exceptionally fine.

units.source_text: 源氏把灯笼放低，仔细观赏，赞道：“这真是精品了！

en.t: Genji lowered the lamp, studied them carefully, and praised them, saying, "These are truly masterpieces!

units.source_text: 现今的人，只学得古人的一端呢。”

en.t: People today can only learn one small part of what the ancients knew."

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王便把这两件作品奉赠，说道：“即使我有女儿，倘使她不会赏识，我也不肯传给她。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, then presented the two works to him, saying, "Even if I had a daughter, if she could not appreciate them, I would not pass them on to her.

units.source_text: 何况我没有女儿，保存此物，有何用处呢！”

en.t: Since I have no daughter, what use is there in keeping them?"

units.source_text: 源氏也有礼物赠与侍从：版本极佳的中国古书，装在一只沉香木制的书箱里，再加一支精美的高丽笛。

en.t: Genji also gave the chamberlain gifts: an excellent edition of an old Chinese book, placed in an aloeswood book box, together with a fine Korean flute.
